aesthetic: Apple-level luxury meets aurora night. Restrained, intentional, with violet as the soul of the interface.
global_rules: Max border-radius: 8px. Use sharp (4px or 0px) edges where appropriate to avoid a bubbly look.
NO Material Design drop shadows. Rely on 1px borders, subtle glows, and pure background contrast.
NO purple gradients on white. Keep the UI dark.
NO card-heavy dashboard feel. Keep it flat, expansive, and immersive.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use .jsx/.js files exclusively. NO .tsx or .ts files.

usage.chat_output: font-serif (Lora) for AI Creative Mode, otherwise sans.

layout.overall: Full viewport height (h-screen), flex/grid layout, hidden overflow on body.

left_sidebar.content: Session history and Mode Switcher. Minimalist session list (title + timestamp, actions on hover).

main_canvas.message_alignment: User messages right-aligned with var(--bg-elevated) background. AI messages left-aligned with NO background (transparent).

api_status_bar.style: Ultra-thin, monospaced font, border-t border-white/5, bg-surface
api_status_bar.status_dots: Green = active, Amber = rate-limited, Red = error

mode_switcher.active_state: Soft violet pill background with 1px violet border glow (box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent-glow)).
mode_switcher.transition: Selected mode slides pill underline with spring ease.

code_blocks.style: Syntax-highlighted output, Copy Code button, language badge.

scrollbars.style: Hidden by default. Visible on hover. 2px wide, violet-tinted (using tailwind scrollbar utilities or custom CSS in index.css).

micro_interactions.code_block: Slides up 8px + fade in (translate-y-2 to translate-y-0, opacity 0 to 1).
micro_interactions.sidebar_session_hover: Left border lights up violet (border-l-2 border-primary).
micro_interactions.loading_indicator: Three dots with aurora gradient pulse.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: 1. Initialize Tailwind with provided colors and fonts. 2. Install lucide-react, framer-motion (for micro-interactions), zustand (for state).
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn: Install Shadcn UI but aggressively override default styles to match the Luxury Dark Theme (remove rounded-xl, borders, and shadows). Use raw Tailwind HTML for layout and Mode Switcher to ensure it matches the highly custom aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.api_key_manager: Build a robust Settings Panel (glassmorphism drawer) to manage keys for multiple providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere, Groq). Encrypt keys if stored, manage state via Zustand.
instructions_to_main_agent.rotation_engine: Implement the API Rotation Engine in the backend (FastAPI) that handles 429 errors by marking keys rate-limited (60s cooldown) and auto-retrying.
instructions_to_main_agent.ai_modes: Ensure each AI Mode injects the correct hidden system prompt before sending to the backend.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chat bubbles, sidebar items) have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.
